description: New releases are held for 7 days so a compromised or yanked publish is caught before it reaches this repo. internalChecksFilter strict makes the age check hold the pull request back instead of only reporting it.

Emergency bypass for a human: merge the pinned version by hand, or temporarily lower minimumReleaseAge in this file on a reviewed pull request that @MikeBrouwers approves. Security fixes need no bypass, vulnerabilityAlerts sets minimumReleaseAge to null so they are never delayed.
